# Homework No. 1

Due: January 22, 2026

A borehole deformation gauge test is conducted within a drill hole initially 5.0 cm in diameter.  Young’s Modulus is known to be 6.897 x 104 MPa.  The U1 axis of the gauge was installed parallel to the true horizontal direction.  The following diametral displacement data were measured following overcoring:

U1 = 1120 micro cm
U2 = 4540 micro cm
U3 = 3340 micro cm

1.    Calculate the principal stresses and their orientation. 
2.    Does this test show the true orientation of the in-situ principal stresses, and if it doesn’t, what would you have to do to measure the true 3-dimensional orientation of the principal stresses?
